title: Josselin Desclodure
text:
Professional, academic or competitive examination backgrounds















Sep 2026 - present


Methodologist / Regional Studies Analyst at Insee Île-de-France (Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques).





Sep 2024 - Jun 2026


Ensai as a Statistician attaché at Insee – École nationale de la statistique et de l’analyse de l’information, Bruz, France.





Sep 2023 - Aug 2024


Civil-servant trainee of Insee - Contrôleur at Cefil (Centre de formation de l’Insee à Libourne).





Pre-2023


Secondary education teacher, BSc in Mathematics at Sorbonne Université, Paris, France (formerly Université Pierre et Marie Curie - Paris 6).





2002


MSc in Physics of liquids at Sorbonne Université, Paris, France.





 Latest projects or publications











2026


Internship at Regional office of Insee Île-de-France: Studied the feasibility of an analysis of high-wealth household in Île-de-France based on the national Wealth and life history survey.





2025


Internship at Directorate-General of Insee Montrouge within the Labour market synthesis and short-term analysis division: Designed the quarterly employment estimates report using an R program and quarto to generate an HTML file.





2024


Internship at Regional office of Insee Île-de-France: Developed a housing allocation tool for Labour force survey interviewers.





2024


Internship at Regional office of Insee Île-de-France: Developed a tool to update dashboards monitoring population census data collection.
